checks: unchanged redraws reuse exact RGBA while emitting each draw_event
back/forward/home reuse visited frames and restore exact original pixels
style and visibility edits rerasterize changed scenes
direct raster and static PNG equal cached current-view pixels
DPI changes invalidate dimensions and LRU respects retained pixel limits
optional cache retention failure still displays a fresh rendered frame
optional cache lookup allocation failure falls back to direct raster
closing releases active and all retained cached RGBA frames
scope: Real withdrawn Tk with programmatic input; no visible presentation or physical-input timing.
